_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular register fragment — never edit shillinq_register.json
_meta.description: Tier 3 — CSRD/ESRS sustainability reporting. Ten new schemas (MaterialityAssessment, IroRecord, EsrsDataPoint, GhgInventory, EmissionSource, ValueChainActor, EsrsPolicy, EsrsAction, EsrsTarget, AssuranceEngagement) plus an additive FixedAsset extension (E1/E4 climate + biodiversity tagging). All quantitative logic is declarative (x-openregister-calculations / x-openregister-aggregations) per ADR-031 — no GHGCalculator.php / ImpactScorer.php services. Lifecycle automation per x-openregister-lifecycle; cross-schema/aggregation preconditions delegated to OCA\Shillinq\Lifecycle\CsrdEsrsGuard (ADR-031 exception path). Seed data pre-loads the ESRS topical taxonomy and a worked FY2025 sample set. Extensions to journal-entry-line and organisations are DEFERRED to the bookkeeping-general-ledger / organisations dependency apps (those schemas are not yet present in shillinq) — see tasks.md.

MaterialityAssessment.title: Materiality Assessment
MaterialityAssessment.description: Root governance record for the CSRD double-materiality determination per reporting period (REQ-CSR-001). Enumerates the ESRS topical taxonomy, captures impact + financial materiality scores, stakeholder-consultation evidence, and the locked double-materiality matrix. Mandatory before any topical disclosure is published (design D2). One per period; restatement via supersededBy self-FK.

assessmentScope.description: Consolidation boundary the assessment applies to (design D1 / open question 3 — manual scope declaration).
assessmentScope.title: Assessment Scope

responsibleOwner.description: Nextcloud user id of the responsible owner (FK to NC user directory — a person is an NC entity, never an invented schema).
responsibleOwner.title: Responsible Owner

stakeholderGroupsConsulted.description: Stakeholder consultation evidence. At least one method per consulted group is mandatory before approval (REQ-CSR-001).

keyOutputs.description: Summary of key outputs from the consultation.
keyOutputs.title: Key Outputs

stakeholderGroupsConsulted.title: Stakeholder Groups Consulted

thresholdImpact.description: Impact-materiality threshold (1-5 scale). A topic is impact-material when its impact score is at or above this threshold (REQ-CSR-001).
thresholdImpact.title: Threshold Impact

thresholdFinancial.description: Financial-materiality threshold (1-5 scale). A topic is financially material when its financial score is at or above this threshold.
thresholdFinancial.title: Threshold Financial

doubleMaterialityMatrixSnapshot.description: Locked snapshot keyed by ESRS topic → {impactScore, financialScore, material, rationale}. Built from the IroRecord children at sign-off (REQ-CSR-001).
doubleMaterialityMatrixSnapshot.title: Double Materiality Matrix Snapshot

approvalDate.description: Date the board/CFO approver signed off.
approvalDate.title: Approval Date

approver.description: Nextcloud user id of the board-level approver (CFO/chair).
approver.title: Approver

supportingDocuments.description: Evidence document references (docudesk file ids / URIs).
supportingDocuments.title: Supporting Documents

supersededBy.description: Self-FK (slug/uuid) to the assessment that supersedes this one on restatement.
supersededBy.title: Superseded By

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: Editable. Topics being scored; consultation in progress.

in-review.label: In review
in-review.description: Stakeholder consultation complete; awaiting board sign-off.

approved.label: Approved
approved.description: Board-signed-off. Matrix frozen; material topics drive topical-module activation (REQ-CSR-001).

locked.label: Locked
locked.description: Published with the period's ESRS report. Immutable; restatement requires a superseding assessment.

submit.label: Submit for board review
submit.description: Submit once every topic is scored and at least one stakeholder group is consulted (REQ-CSR-001).

approve.label: Board sign-off
approve.description: Board approver signs off. Non-material topics must carry a written rationale (REQ-CSR-001).

publish.label: Lock and publish
publish.description: Lock the matrix and publish it with the ESRS report (design D2).

reopen.label: Return to draft
reopen.description: Return to draft for further scoring or consultation.

IroRecord.title: IRO Record
IroRecord.description: Per-topic Impact / Risk / Opportunity entry feeding a MaterialityAssessment (REQ-CSR-001, design D1). impactScore and financialMaterialityScore are computed declaratively; material is derived from the parent assessment thresholds.

esrsTopicCode.description: ESRS topic / sub-topic code, e.g. E1, E1-1, S1, S1-1, G1.
esrsTopicCode.title: Esrs Topic Code

valueChainLocation.description: Where in the value chain the IRO sits (EFRAG IG-2).
valueChainLocation.title: Value Chain Location

grossOrNet.description: Whether the score is before or after mitigation.
grossOrNet.title: Gross Or Net

financialEffectEstimateLow.description: Low bound of the financial-effect estimate.
financialEffectEstimateLow.title: Financial Effect Estimate Low

financialEffectEstimateHigh.description: High bound of the financial-effect estimate.
financialEffectEstimateHigh.title: Financial Effect Estimate High

material.description: Computed at assessment sign-off: true when impactScore >= thresholdImpact OR financialMaterialityScore >= thresholdFinancial.
material.title: Material

owner.description: NC user id of the owner.
owner.title: Owner

impactScore.description: Composite impact-materiality score: (severityOrMagnitude + scope + likelihood) weighted by irremediable character (REQ-CSR-001, design D1). Declarative formula per ADR-031 — no ImpactScorer.php.

financialMaterialityScore.description: Financial-materiality composite. Average of severity and likelihood as financial proxies until the per-dimension financial inputs are split out (REQ-CSR-001).

EsrsDataPoint.title: ESRS Data Point
EsrsDataPoint.description: One row per ESRS-mandated data point per period (~1,100 per period across the 12 standards) (REQ-CSR-002, design D3). Configurable source + progressive approval lifecycle. No transition to approved without a source reference (assurance-critical control).

valueNumeric.description: Numeric/monetary/quantity value when valueType is numeric/monetary/quantity.
valueNumeric.title: Value Numeric

valueText.description: Text value when valueType is text.
valueText.title: Value Text

valueBoolean.description: Boolean value when valueType is boolean.
valueBoolean.title: Value Boolean

unit.description: UN/CEFACT unit code (e.g. tCO2e, H87, EUR).
unit.title: Unit

valueSource.description: Configured source of the value (REQ-CSR-002, design D3).
valueSource.title: Value Source

sourceReference.description: URI / docudesk reference / GL line reference evidencing the value. Mandatory before approval.
sourceReference.title: Source Reference

preparer.description: NC user id of the preparer.
preparer.title: Preparer

preparerTimestamp.description: When the preparer entered/submitted the value.
preparerTimestamp.title: Preparer Timestamp

reviewer.description: NC user id of the reviewer.
reviewer.title: Reviewer

reviewerTimestamp.description: When the reviewer approved the value.
reviewerTimestamp.title: Reviewer Timestamp

status.description: Progressive approval status (design D9). Mirrors the lifecycle field.
status.title: Status

restatedFrom.description: Self-FK to the prior-period data point this value restates (REQ-CSR-002, design D8).
restatedFrom.title: Restated From

restatementRationale.description: Mandatory rationale when restatedFrom is set (design D8).
restatementRationale.title: Restatement Rationale

locked-for-assurance.label: Locked for assurance
locked-for-assurance.description: Read-only to the entity; auditor may annotate but not change the value (REQ-CSR-004, design D5).

assured.label: Assured
assured.description: Auditor signed off. Ready for XBRL mapping (REQ-CSR-005).

published.label: Published
published.description: Filed with KvK/AFM. Immutable; changes flow through restatement (design D8).

submit.label: Submit for review
submit.description: Preparer submits the value for review (REQ-CSR-002).

approve.label: Approve
approve.description: Reviewer approves. Blocked unless a source reference is present (REQ-CSR-002 assurance control).

reject.label: Reject
reject.description: Reviewer returns the data point to draft.

lockForAssurance.label: Lock for assurance
lockForAssurance.description: Freeze the value for the auditor; entity edits forbidden (design D5).

assure.label: Auditor sign-off
assure.description: Auditor signs off the data point (REQ-CSR-004).

restate.label: Restate
restate.description: Create a corrected value in a subsequent period with restatedFrom + rationale (design D8).

GhgInventory.title: GHG Inventory
GhgInventory.description: GHG Protocol Scope 1/2/3 calculation engine per period (REQ-CSR-003, design D4). Totals are declarative aggregations over the period's EmissionSource rows — no GHGCalculator.php (ADR-031). Base-year recalculation flagged at the >=5% boundary-change threshold.

esrsTaxonomyVersion.description: Pinned EFRAG ESRS XBRL taxonomy version for this period (REQ-CSR-005, design D7).
esrsTaxonomyVersion.title: Esrs Taxonomy Version

baseYearRecalculationFlag.description: True when a >=5% boundary change has triggered base-year recalculation (REQ-CSR-003, design D4).
baseYearRecalculationFlag.title: Base Year Recalculation Flag

intensityHeadcount.description: FTE headcount denominator for the per-FTE intensity metric.
intensityHeadcount.title: Intensity Headcount

intensityTurnover.description: Turnover denominator (EUR) for the per-turnover intensity metric.
intensityTurnover.title: Intensity Turnover

intensityFloorAreaM2.description: Floor-area denominator (m2) for the per-m2 intensity metric.
intensityFloorAreaM2.title: Intensity Floor Area M2

intensityUnitsProduced.description: Units-produced denominator for the per-unit intensity metric.
intensityUnitsProduced.title: Intensity Units Produced

scope1Total.description: total-Scope-1 = SUM(EmissionSource.co2eResult) for scope=1 rows of this inventory (REQ-CSR-003 / design D4).

scope2LocationBasedTotal.description: total-Scope-2-location-based = SUM(co2eResult) for scope=2 rows using grid-average factors (REQ-CSR-003).

scope2MarketBasedTotal.description: total-Scope-2-market-based = SUM(co2eResult) for scope=2 rows using contract-specific factors (REQ-CSR-003).

scope3ByCategory.description: total-Scope-3 broken down by the 15 GHG Protocol categories: SUM(co2eResult) grouped by category for scope LIKE '3-cat-%' rows (REQ-CSR-003).

calculated.label: Calculated
calculated.description: On-demand aggregation rolled up Scope 1/2/3 totals (design D4).

reopen.label: Reopen
reopen.description: Return to draft to adjust emission sources.

EmissionSource.title: Emission Source
EmissionSource.description: Per-activity row feeding a GhgInventory (REQ-CSR-003, design D4). co2eResult is a declarative calculation (activityData x emissionFactor) — no PHP service.

category.description: Activity category, e.g. mobile-combustion, purchased-electricity, employee-commuting.
category.title: Category

scope2Method.description: For scope=2 rows: which Scope-2 accounting method this row contributes to (REQ-CSR-003).
scope2Method.title: Scope2Method

activityData.description: Activity quantity in standard units (litres, kWh, km, EUR spend).
activityData.title: Activity Data

activitySourceDocument.description: File / openconnector reference evidencing the activity data.
activitySourceDocument.title: Activity Source Document

uncertaintyRating.description: Uncertainty rating; spend-based proxies are typically high (REQ-CSR-003).
uncertaintyRating.title: Uncertainty Rating

recalculationFlag.description: True when this row restates prior base-year emissions (M&A / divestiture / methodology change).
recalculationFlag.title: Recalculation Flag

co2eResult.description: co2eResult = activityData x emissionFactor (tCO2e). Declarative per ADR-031 / design D4 — no GHGCalculator.php.

ValueChainActor.title: Value Chain Actor
ValueChainActor.description: Supplier / customer / portfolio-company in the reporting boundary (REQ-CSR-002, design D1). counterparty references the organisations entity master (FK by slug/uuid) — that schema lives in the organisations dependency app, never re-invented here.

counterparty.description: FK (slug/uuid) to an organisations record (entity master in the organisations dependency app).
counterparty.title: Counterparty

counterpartyName.description: Denormalised counterparty name for display until the organisations FK resolves.
counterpartyName.title: Counterparty Name

inScopeFor.description: ESRS standard codes this actor is in scope for.
inScopeFor.title: In Scope For

dataCollectionMethod.description: How data is collected from this actor.
dataCollectionMethod.title: Data Collection Method

EsrsPolicy.title: ESRS Policy
EsrsPolicy.description: ESRS-2 governance triad — policy declaration on a material topic (design D1).

owner.description: NC user id of the policy owner.
owner.title: Owner

measurementMetric.description: FK (slug/uuid) to the EsrsDataPoint that measures this policy.
measurementMetric.title: Measurement Metric

EsrsAction.title: ESRS Action
EsrsAction.description: ESRS-2 governance triad — concrete time-bound intervention on a material topic (design D1).

owner.description: NC user id of the action owner.
owner.title: Owner

measurementMetric.description: FK (slug/uuid) to the EsrsDataPoint that measures this action.
measurementMetric.title: Measurement Metric

EsrsTarget.title: ESRS Target
EsrsTarget.description: ESRS-2 governance triad — measurable, preferably science-based goal on a material topic (design D1).

owner.description: NC user id of the target owner.
owner.title: Owner

measurementMetric.description: FK (slug/uuid) to the EsrsDataPoint that measures this target.
measurementMetric.title: Measurement Metric

AssuranceEngagement.title: Assurance Engagement
AssuranceEngagement.description: External-auditor assurance engagement per period (REQ-CSR-004, design D5). Limited assurance (year 1) escalating to reasonable assurance (FY2028+). Findings tracked to management response; submission confirmation captured for XBRL/KvK deposition.

esrsDataPointId.title: Esrs Data Point ID
esrsDataPointId.description: The date and time for esrs data point id.

sampleSize.title: Sample Size
sampleSize.description: The numeric value for sample size.

findings.description: Auditor findings tracked to management response (REQ-CSR-004).

status.title: Status
status.description: The current status of this record.

findings.title: Findings

opinionDate.description: Date the partner signed the opinion.
opinionDate.title: Opinion Date

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: Engagement set up; scope and materiality being agreed.

fieldwork.label: Fieldwork
fieldwork.description: Auditor performing controls + substantive testing on locked data points (REQ-CSR-004).

opinion-issued.label: Opinion issued
opinion-issued.description: All findings resolved/accepted; partner signed the opinion.

startFieldwork.label: Start fieldwork
startFieldwork.description: Begin walkthrough once data points are locked-for-assurance (REQ-CSR-004).

issueOpinion.label: Issue opinion
issueOpinion.description: Partner issues the opinion once all findings are resolved/accepted (REQ-CSR-004).

issueOpinionNoFindings.label: Issue opinion (no findings)
issueOpinionNoFindings.description: Issue the opinion directly when fieldwork raised no findings.

isBiodiversitySensitiveAreaOverlap.description: REQ-CSR ESRS E4 — whether the asset's location overlaps a Natura 2000 / Key Biodiversity Area (computed from geolocation against the WDPA overlay, or manual override). Additive ADR-037 extension merged onto the monolith FixedAsset schema (design D6).
isBiodiversitySensitiveAreaOverlap.title: Is Biodiversity Sensitive Area Overlap

physicalClimateRiskRating.description: REQ-CSR ESRS E1 — physical-climate-risk rating (1-5) for the asset's site, manually assessed from flood/fire/drought exposure (design D6). Additive ADR-037 extension.
physicalClimateRiskRating.title: Physical Climate Risk Rating

stakeholderGroupsConsulted.keyOutputs: Water and waste flagged as top concerns.

E1.rationale: Material climate impact and transition risk.

S4.rationale: Niche B2B chemical distribution; no end-consumer health/safety events in past 3 years.

objects.description: Scope 1/2/3 GHG emissions from operations and supply chain.
objects.rationale: Climate change is material on both impact and financial dimensions.

objects.boundaryNarrative: Three sites: Amsterdam office, Eindhoven office, warehouse.

objects.scopeStatement: Limited assurance of ESRS E1 (GHG Scope 1/2/3) and S1 (headcount) per ISSA 5000.
